email_subject: Application - Internship at European Landowners' Organization
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the internship at the European Landowners' Organization. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your communication efforts in agriculture and environment policy.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and ran technical audits to improve search visibility. I am proficient in Canva, Mailchimp, WordPress, and Microsoft Office, and I thrive in international settings.

I am passionate about communication strategies and eager to support event organization, newsletter creation, and social media. Based in Belgium, I am available to start ASAP.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to ELO's impactful work.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the internship at the European Landowners' Organization. Your focus on agriculture, environment, and rural policy resonates with my passion for communication and digital strategy. I am confident that my skills in content creation, design, and web management can support ELO's impactful projects.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I also use Canva to create visuals for social media and newsletters. On my personal project, mirook.com, I designed a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data, and ran technical audits to improve search visibility. This experience has honed my ability to manage multiple communication channels and deliver high-quality content.

I am proficient in Mailchimp, WordPress, Canva, and Microsoft Office, and I am comfortable with project management tools. My background includes social media coordination and performance reporting. I am eager to contribute to event organization, newsletter creation, and website updates. Based in Belgium, I am available to start immediately and excited to bring my creativity and initiative to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to ELO's mission.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
